*5G NR for RF Engineers*, following the *5G Under the Hood* series: four
chapters of six sections each. Every section starts with the basic idea in
plain words and goes step by step to the 3GPP detail and field practice, so
it works for beginners and for experienced RF engineers alike. Take the
chapters in order: each builds on the one before.
